screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.title: Recipe Forest Settings
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.resolut:
Controls which roots receive a recipe assigned to an ingredient.
Click to choose a scope.

Assigns the selected recipe in §aevery root§r.
Use this when roots should share the same ingredient choices.

Assigns the selected recipe only in roots whose current trees contain the ingredient.
Other roots keep their existing choices.

Assigns the selected recipe only in the currently selected root.
Every other root keeps its own choice.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.root_la:
Controls how roots are arranged in the panel on the right.
Click to choose a layout.

Shows one detailed root per row.
Provides batch buttons and controls for reordering roots.

Shows roots as compact cells across multiple pages.
Grid dimensions are configured under Detailed Settings.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.quantit:
Controls how box, stack, and item amounts appear while holding §6[alt]§r.
Click to choose a display style.
Shows boxes, stacks, and remaining items with compact icons.
Shows boxes, stacks, and remaining items as labeled text.
config.emi.tooltip.binds.view_stack_tree:
Adds the hovered stack's preferred recipe to the Recipe Forest.
Does not open another screen.
config.emi.tooltip.binds.view_tree:
Opens the current Recipe Forest.
Replaces EMI's single Recipe Tree action.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.forest_: §c[R]§r is reserved by EMI's recipe lookup

Adds the recipe under the pointer to the Recipe Forest.
Over an item, adds its preferred tree-capable recipe instead.
Accepts up to four key, scan-code, or mouse bindings.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.box_ena:
Groups large expanded quantities into boxes before showing stacks and items.
Each box uses the configured stack capacity.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.stacks_:
Sets how many full stacks one box represents.
Range: §61–256§r. Default: §627§r.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.list_le:
Limits the number of root rows visible at once in List layout.
Additional roots remain available through the scrollbar.
Range: §61–256§r. Default: §664§r.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.grid_si:
Sets how many root cells appear on each Grid page.
Columns: §61–16§r. Rows: §61–8§r. Default: §68 × 2§r.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.columns: Sets the number of columns on each Grid page.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.rows.to: Sets the number of rows on each Grid page.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.details: Jump to Detailed Recipe Forest Settings
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.reset.t:
Restores the scope, layout, quantity, binding, and panel settings to their defaults.
A confirmation screen appears before anything changes.
screen.emi_recipeforest.settings.reset.c: This restores every Recipe Forest setting to its default value. This action can be reverted before leaving EMI Config.
tooltip.emi_recipeforest.add_to_forest:
§bAdd to Recipe Forest§r

tooltip.emi_recipeforest.recipe_tree.des: Opens EMI's Recipe Tree when the Forest is empty

§6[×]§r Remove the selected root
